title: Normalize reviewed campaign payload bytes through the native guarded writer
body:
Normalize reviewed campaign payload serialization through the guarded native writer before acceptance

Independent review of all68 proposed promotions found19 exact candidate payloads whose parsed records equal their native guarded-writer output, but whose bytes differ. `campaign_owner_apply.prepare` correctly refuses them with `Reviewed payload is not native-rendered bytes`. The guard must remain unchanged. Most observed differences are line wrapping/quoting; parsed equality must be verified for every candidate rather than assumed.

This is a candidate construction defect, not an identity or scientific rejection. Create immutable normalized successors using the repository's actual guarded writer, preserve every original payload and origin/preimage binding, verify complete parsed-object equality and all curation history, then obtain separate exact-byte review. A private diagnostic render is not automatically an accepted replacement. Audit the complete selected campaign, not only the68-promotion subset, before preparing its final plan. Any semantic difference must stop normalization for that record and be independently triaged.

Coordinator rehashed all1,017 members. Author overlaps are disclosed; this is technical review, not fresh68-owner scientific approval. EBIOS source-kind conflict and Trypticase identity collision are separate refusals and stay blocked.

Live all-state serialization search found existing date, private receipt-binding and export issues but not this exact reviewed-payload rendering defect. No source or maintained file has been changed, and no application is authorized by this issue alone. No threshold, gate, writer behavior or scientific hold should be weakened.
